name: bash
description: Run a bash command and return its stdout and stderr.

name: sib
description: Run a sib command on the store that holds this conversation. Your own conversation is HEAD; each item (message, function call, output) is one commit, so HEAD~1 is the item before the latest. Examples: ["log", "-n", "5"] shows your conversation with each item cut to 5 lines; ["show", "HEAD~3"] shows one item and ["show", "HEAD~3:content"] only its content; ["save", "-l"] lists saved conversations and ["log", "-n", "5", "<name>"] reads one; ["git", "log", "--all", "-i", "-G<regex>", "--format=%h"] finds items whose content matches; ["edit", "HEAD~3"] with content replaces that item's content in your own conversation, e.g. to shorten it, and the conversation continues from the edited version. ask is not allowed.

content.description: New content of the item, only with ["edit", <item>].
